config.name: Denied connections per minute, by firewall
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS ts,
       firewall,
       count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS "denied/min"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'Cisco ASA' AS firewall, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, if(coalesce(cisco_asa_rule_name, '') = '', concat('ASA ', coalesce(event_code, '')), cisco_asa_rule_name) AS rule
      FROM dfe.`cisco-asa`
      WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'FortiGate' AS firewall, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, concat('policy ', toString(rule_id)) AS rule
      FROM dfe.fortinet
      WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND event_action = 'deny')
GROUP BY ts, firewall
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Top denied sources
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT firewall AS "Firewall",
       src AS "Source",
       rule AS "Rule",
       count() AS "Denied"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'Cisco ASA' AS firewall, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, if(coalesce(cisco_asa_rule_name, '') = '', concat('ASA ', coalesce(event_code, '')), cisco_asa_rule_name) AS rule
      FROM dfe.`cisco-asa`
      WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'FortiGate' AS firewall, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, concat('policy ', toString(rule_id)) AS rule
      FROM dfe.fortinet
      WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND event_action = 'deny')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 12

config.name: Denied by rule
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT firewall AS "Firewall",
       rule AS "Rule",
       count() AS "Denied",
       uniqExact(src) AS "Sources"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'Cisco ASA' AS firewall, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, if(coalesce(cisco_asa_rule_name, '') = '', concat('ASA ', coalesce(event_code, '')), cisco_asa_rule_name) AS rule
      FROM dfe.`cisco-asa`
      WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'FortiGate' AS firewall, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, concat('policy ', toString(rule_id)) AS rule
      FROM dfe.fortinet
      WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND event_action = 'deny')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 12
